name: sudoku_9x9
prompt_template:
Solve the following {size}x{size} Sudoku.

Rules:
- A 0 represents an empty cell.
- Replace every 0 with an integer from 1 to {size}.
- Each row must contain the numbers 1 through {size} exactly once.
- Each column must contain the numbers 1 through {size} exactly once.
- Each {box_rows}x{box_columns} box must contain 1 through {size} exactly once.
- Do not change any original nonzero number.

Puzzle:
{puzzle}

Return the completed grid. No zeros may remain.
Check all rows, columns, boxes, and original clues before answering.

Return exactly one <answer>...</answer> block.
Inside the block, return a JSON array of {size} arrays of {size} integers each.
Do not include explanations, comments, Markdown fences, or text outside the block.
